title: Modal
description: A dialog that interrupts the page for a focused task. Focus is trapped inside, Escape and a backdrop click close it, and focus returns to the opener. On narrow screens it becomes a bottom sheet.

support.notes: Dialog (alias Modal): Android back button closes it

api.notes: Dialog (alias Modal): Android back button closes it

ModalProps.open: Controlled open state; leave undefined for uncontrolled
ModalProps.onOpenChange: Called with the requested open state (trigger, close button, Escape, backdrop click)
ModalProps.trigger: Element that opens it on click (single element, rendered with asChild)
ModalProps.title: Title, used as the dialog's accessible name
ModalProps.description: Description below the title, used as the accessible description
ModalProps.closeLabel: Accessible label of the close button; defaults to the localized "Close"
ModalProps.role: ARIA role of the dialog panel; use "alertdialog" for confirmations that interrupt the user
ModalProps.className: Additional class name of the panel
ModalProps.children: Body: usually ModalBody + ModalFooter, or a <form> wrapping them

ModalRootProps.open: Controlled open state; leave undefined for uncontrolled
ModalRootProps.onOpenChange: Called with the requested open state (trigger, close button, Escape, backdrop click)
ModalRootProps.modal: Modal mode: renders the backdrop, traps focus, locks page scrolling, blocks outside interaction and hides the page from assistive technology

ModalTriggerProps.asChild: Merges the behaviour onto the single child element instead of rendering its own element

ModalContentProps.closeLabel: Accessible label of the close button; defaults to the localized "Close"
ModalContentProps.description: Visible description below the title, linked as the accessible description (aria-describedby is omitted without one)
ModalContentProps.role: ARIA role of the panel; use "alertdialog" for confirmations that interrupt the user
ModalContentProps.forceMount: Keeps the panel mounted while closed (data-state="closed"), e.g. for animation libraries
ModalContentProps.onOpenAutoFocus: Called before focus moves into the panel on open; event.preventDefault() keeps focus where it is
ModalContentProps.onCloseAutoFocus: Called before focus returns to the opener on close; event.preventDefault() skips it
ModalContentProps.onEscapeKeyDown: Escape pressed while it is the topmost layer; event.preventDefault() keeps it open
ModalContentProps.onPointerDownOutside: Pointer pressed outside; event.preventDefault() keeps it open
ModalContentProps.onInteractOutside: Pointer down or focus outside; event.preventDefault() keeps it open

cssVars.--modal-radius: Corner radius of the panel (defaults to --radius-xl)
cssVars.--modal-z-index: Stacking order of the panel (defaults to --z-modal)

basic.title: Basic usage
basic.description: The trigger slot opens the modal; label and description name and describe it. Focus is trapped, Escape and an overlay click close it, and focus returns to the opener.

sizes.title: Sizes
sizes.description: Five size presets, set before calling show(). The title comes from the header slot here.

form.title: Form in a modal
form.description: A footer submit button targets the form by id; the browser validates it, then the submit handler saves and calls hide().

events.title: Events and guarded close
events.description: minerva-open-change is cancelable: while "Unsaved changes" is checked, preventDefault() keeps the modal open. The log shows the reason and the after-open / after-close events.

props.label: Title text (or use the header slot); names the dialog.
props.dialogRole: ARIA role of the panel; "alertdialog" for interrupting confirmations.

events.minerva-open-change: The user asked to open / close (detail: { open, reason }); cancelable: preventDefault() keeps the current state.
events.minerva-after-open: Fired once the panel is open and focus has moved in.
events.minerva-after-close: Fired once the panel has finished closing (after its exit animation).

slots.trigger: Element that opens the panel when clicked.

basic.title: Basic usage
basic.description: Cancel closes without deleting. Delete closes the dialog and displays Record deleted.

confirm.title: Confirmation
confirm.description: confirmLabel / onConfirm and onCancel render the footer buttons; onOpenChange reports the close reason (confirm, cancel, mask, back).

custom-footer.title: Custom footer
custom-footer.description: footer replaces the buttons with any content; size sets the width.

form.title: Form
form.description: Rename Quarterly report by editing Name and pressing Save. The trigger then displays the saved name.

native.limitations: Native Dialog uses onPress actions rather than HTML form submission. It has no ModalRoot/ModalTrigger compound API or xlarge size; the web compound and xlarge examples are therefore not reproduced.
